Spec §8 forbids new rules, registries, check scripts, hooks, required fields and
mandatory documents by default. A proposal answers all three questions before it
is implemented.

## 1. Which concrete failure does it prevent?

<!-- A failure that has actually happened, not one that might. -->

## 2. What effort does it create for every future change?

<!-- Time per commit, PR or issue; files to maintain; knowledge to learn. -->

## 3. Which cheaper alternative exists?

<!-- Types, generation, colocation — or doing nothing. -->

## Proposal

<!-- What exactly would be added, and where? -->

## Decision

<!-- Product owner only: approved (link the commit or ADR) or rejected, with the reason. -->
